in_sanskrit.name: Aks
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Short arrow, swift
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Aks एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'aksh', meaning 'short', 'arrow', or 'swift'. In Hindu mythology, 'Aks' is associated with the god Shiva, symbolizing his power and swiftness.
